run_convert_spj_to_predictions: run the CLI tool to convert SPJ predictions to answer predictions and compute F1 scores
generate_answers_argmax: generate answers for argmax questions by finding keys with the highest value from question facts
post_process_instances: post process multiple prediction instances by majority voting on types and generating final answers
try_numeric: check if a string is numeric after stripping unit suffixes like kg, pound, or percent
extract_operator: extract the operator token from a model prediction string by parsing the first bracketed token
